source: NOAA GHCN-Daily and supplemental Cyprus Department of Meteorology
qc: Exclude GHCN missing -9999 and any nonblank Q flag. Accepted years >=95% annual AND >=95% November-March (NH) or May-September (SH) accepted TMIN days. No gapfill. Cyprus accepted paired CSV independent source sanity checks, no sourceQCflags.

selectionProtocol.target: Mean matched annual (station TNn minus ERA5EX TNn) residual; each station contributes equal fit weight. Original-year comparison uses >=95% annual and cold-season QC-passed daily TMIN coverage.
selectionProtocol.cv: Leave one of eight predefined geographic regions out, fit on seven. Report station-equal averages of annual MAE, absolute mean error and threshold-frequency absolute error.
selectionProtocol.featurePeriod: ERA5 mean1991-2020 and standard deviation1991-2025, sampled at nearest native 0.1 degree point (or explicitly flagged nearest valid land within15km). Native CHELSA BIO06 at station and native reference point, 1981-2010.
selectionProtocol.selection: All fixed model candidates reported. A smallest adequate model is selected using >=5% annual MAE improvement with meanbias improvement and no held-region annual MAE deterioration >0.5C. This is model selection using CV, not an independent final accuracy claim.
limitations: Target is thermometer temperature, not edible-olive yield or crop-loss probability.
Eight regions and 49 stations are sparse; missing Japan/Chile/North Africa coverage is explicit.
Station neighbours are not fully independent climate samples. Hold-region tests reduce direct geographic leakage.
Native CHELSA data and ERA5 products share reanalysis inputs; station observations are the validation target.
95% daily coverage can still miss annual extreme, with a likely warm bias in the station target.
Calendar-year TNn does not measure acclimation, freeze duration, phenological timing or orchard cold pools.
